recognized_test_commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'gofmt -w roles.go roles_test.go
GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test . ./lib/utils -count=1'

/bin/bash -lc "grep -R -n --include='*test.go' 'func TestUtils' lib/utils
GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/utils -run '"'^TestUtils$'"' -check.f 'RolesTestSuite' -count=1
git diff --check
git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "gofmt -w roles.go roles_test.go
GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test . -count=1
GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/utils -run '"'^TestUtils$'"' -check.f 'RolesTestSuite' -count=1
git diff --check"

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
